summary: All four files contain substantial formal mathematical content and should remain in the primary search index. Example.lean provides 30+ worked examples of Gröbner basis problems (remainders, bases, ideal/radical membership, ideal equality) with tactic proofs. Lemma.lean proves the Rabinovich method for radical membership and supporting lemmas. Tactic.lean implements the full gb_solve tactic with polynomial representations, external solver integration, parsing, and multiple sub-tactics (remainder, basis, idealeq, ideal_membership, radical_membership, add_gb_hyp). Template.lean gives manual proof templates for the same problem classes. None are pure import aggregators or duplicates; all contribute unique definitions, statements, proofs, or tactic interfaces.
